title: 1964 Alaska great earthquake and tsunami
summary: A moment magnitude 9.2 earthquake struck south-central Alaska on March 27, 1964. It was felt over almost 502,000 square miles, tilted and uplifted large areas, and triggered submarine landslides and tsunamis, with damage as far as Crescent City, California. The death toll was 131, but property damage was high.

importance.justification: One of the largest recorded earthquakes (Mw 9.2), with Pacific-wide tsunami effects and major scientific significance.

sources.title: Alaska earthquake of 1964 | Magnitude 9.2, Tsunami, Destruction, & Facts | Britannica

reviewer_note: The ISC origin time is 28 March 03:36 UTC, which corresponds to 27 March local time; I used 27 March as in Britannica.
